US President Trump says India-US trade deal is 'pretty close'

US President Donald Trump has stated that a trade deal between India and the United States is "pretty close" to finalization. He indicated that the agreement would be "much different" from earlier pacts but did not provide further details. Senator Marco Rubio also commented that the deal was "very close."
